---
name: implement-feature
description: Plan and implement a feature through the AI development team workflow.
disable-model-invocation: true
---
Implement the described feature using DISCOVER → PLAN → ARCHITECT → SPECIALIST REVIEW → IMPLEMENT → TEST → SECURITY → FINAL REVIEW.

Before editing, define acceptance criteria, affected components, risks and rollback. For EMS/HA/Modbus changes, classify the work as read-only, simulated, configuration or physical write. Do not perform physical writes. Require verified interfaces and human confirmation for any later write test. Finish with changed files, test evidence, limitations and READY FOR HUMAN REVIEW.
